title: Nearest Outpost Locator
description: A logistics corporation wants to set up automated drone delivery routes from a central fulfillment hub located at coordinates (0, 0) on a 2D grid. Given a list of customer outpost coordinates and an integer K, find the K closest outposts to the central hub. Distance is measured using standard Euclidean distance. You may return the answer in any order.
input_format: An array of coordinate pairs representing outposts and an integer K.
output_format: An array of the K closest coordinate pairs.

examples.explanation: Distance of [1,3] is sqrt(10), distance of [-2,2] is sqrt(8). The closest is [-2,2].
Distances are sqrt(18), sqrt(26), and sqrt(20). The two closest are [3,3] and [-2,4].
Both outposts are at a distance of 1 from the origin.
